mechanism: Both drugs are teratogens and benazepril (ACE inhibitor) combined with isotretinoin significantly increases risk of fetal abnormalities; additionally, isotretinoin may potentiate the hypotensive effects of benazepril.
action: Avoid combination in patients of childbearing potential; if unavoidable, ensure dual contraception with isotretinoin and monitor blood pressure closely due to additive hypotensive effects.
